testimonials.name: Priya Sharma
testimonials.quote: ABTalks SE track was the best decision of my 3rd year. The daily streak forced me to code even on bad days — and that consistency got me my Amazon internship. The GitHub + LinkedIn combo built a portfolio that spoke louder than my CGPA.

testimonials.name: Arjun Mehta
testimonials.quote: I was stuck in tutorial hell. ABTalks forced me to actually build. 60 days later I had 12 real data projects on GitHub. The recruiter from Swiggy literally found me from my LinkedIn posts.

testimonials.name: Sneha Patel

testimonials.name: Rohan Singh

testimonials.quote: 60 days. 60 GitHub commits. 60 LinkedIn posts. By the end, I had 800 followers who cared about my work, a co-founder, and the first user of my startup. ABTalks literally changed my life trajectory.
